free_parameters.name: partial_weight_ratio
free_parameters.why: not named in the witness; 0.5 makes int(head_dim*ratio)=4 a non-empty index set. The target guard only tests `is not None`, so its truth value is independent of the ratio.

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed torch seed so the random tensors and the trace hash are reproducible

free_parameters.name: n_head
free_parameters.why: head count small enough for a fast CPU run; the target guard does not read n_head

free_parameters.name: head_dim
free_parameters.why: per-head dimension; only used after the target decision and does not affect the guard

free_parameters.name: batch_size
free_parameters.why: small batch for a fast CPU run; the target guard does not read the batch size

free_parameters.name: seq_len
free_parameters.why: short sequence for a fast CPU run; the target guard does not read the sequence length

free_parameters.name: dtype
free_parameters.why: CPU-only run; float16 matmul is not implemented on CPU in this torch build, and the guard only tests warmup / partial_weight_ratio
